name: Rockland Rookies 2026

venue.name: Palisades Center
venue.address: 1000 Palisades Center Dr, West Nyack, NY 10994
venue.details: 4th Floor, Harry & Thelma Adler Community Room

information: This is a series competition with [Rockland Rounds 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RocklandRounds2026). Please note that you may only register for and compete at one of the two. The Harry & Thelma Adler Community Room is located on the 4th floor in front of the Ice Skating Rink on your right hand side.
